title: Lady Bugg and its origin in Maine
summary: Lady Bugg came from a party jam in Yarmouth, Maine, with words by his wife Verena.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Yeah. I wanted to say I enjoyed that tune that’s on your website called “Lady Bugg.”
Well the one that I’m working on now that has me excited is “Lady Bugg #2.” It’s the same structure but the melodies are just absolutely amazing.

“Lady Bugg” originated from a jam session that we had a neighbor’s house in Maine, in Yarmouth, Maine. I had some wonderful neighbors and we were having a party and I sat at the piano and my new, my recently married Verena, who you just met, she would sing something. So I just tried something in D minor and that’s how that tune sprang and how it came alive.
And she wrote the words to it.
